description: This file defines the internal class DynamoDBGatewayListProvider which implements IGatewayListProvider. It manages gateway list retrieval from DynamoDB for Orleans clustering, including initialization and querying for active gateways.

classes.name: DynamoDBGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Implements IGatewayListProvider to fetch and manage gateway addresses from DynamoDB for Orleans clustering.

methods.name: DynamoDBGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies and configuration options.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes DynamoDB storage and sets up the DynamoDB table with key schema and attribute definitions.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of active gateway URIs from DynamoDB based on specific filtering criteria.
